Title: Support for Linux workloads in the App Service Migration Assistant tool

Body.Content:
The App Service Migration Assistant tool now supports migrating containerized web applications from on-premises container images to App Service on Linux. The tool will perform pre-defined readiness checks and allow customers to choose either Azure Container Registry or Docker hub as container image repository and then deploy the container image to App Service on Linux.

Assess and migrate your web apps
